brief:
Israeli occupation forces stormed residential buildings in the Silwan neighborhood of occupied East Jerusalem to enforce property seizure orders, the Shehab Wire reported. The military operation targeted homes slated for confiscation under Israeli administrative decisions.

Silwan, located in the heart of East Jerusalem, has long been a flashpoint for Israeli settlement expansion and Palestinian displacement. The neighborhood has experienced repeated raids and property seizures as part of broader efforts to alter the demographic composition of the occupied territory. The operation adds to a pattern of forced evictions and home confiscations that have displaced Palestinian families from their properties in recent years.
